column.name: name_en
column.value: Mediterranean Diet

column.name: description_en
column.value: The Mediterranean diet is based on the traditional food of countries around the Mediterranean Sea. It includes plenty of vegetables, fruits, grains, fish and olive oil, and limited amounts of red meat and sugar.

column.name: benefits_en
column.value: Reduces risk of cardiovascular disease, improves brain function and supports healthy weight loss.

column.name: name_en
column.value: Keto Diet

column.name: description_en
column.value: The keto diet is a high-fat, very low-carb diet that forces the body to use fat for energy instead of carbs. It includes meat, fish, eggs, low-carb vegetables and healthy fats.

column.name: benefits_en
column.value: Fast weight loss, improved mental clarity, reduced appetite and stabilized blood sugar.

column.name: name_en
column.value: Vegan Diet

column.name: description_en
column.value: The vegan diet excludes all animal products including meat, fish, eggs, dairy and honey. Focus is on fruits, vegetables, grains, legumes, nuts and seeds.

column.name: benefits_en
column.value: Reduces risk of chronic disease, improves heart health, supports weight loss and is more environmentally sustainable.

column.name: name_en
column.value: Paleo Diet

column.name: description_en
column.value: The Paleo diet mimics the food of our stone-age ancestors. It includes meat, fish, eggs, fruits, vegetables, nuts and seeds, but excludes grains, legumes, dairy and processed food.

column.name: benefits_en
column.value: Improves energy, reduces inflammation, supports weight loss and improves digestion.

column.name: name_en
column.value: Intermittent Fasting (IF)

column.name: description_en
column.value: Intermittent fasting is not a diet in the traditional sense, but an eating pattern that alternates periods of eating and fasting. Popular forms include 16:8 (16 hours fasting, 8-hour eating window) and 5:2 (5 days normal eating, 2 days restricted calories).

column.name: benefits_en
column.value: Supports weight loss, improves metabolism, reduces inflammation and may improve longevity.

column.name: name_en
column.value: DASH Diet

column.name: description_en
column.value: DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) is specifically designed to lower blood pressure. It includes plenty of fruits, vegetables, low-fat dairy, grains, fish, poultry and nuts, and limits sodium, sugar and red meat.

column.name: benefits_en
column.value: Effectively lowers blood pressure, improves heart health and supports healthy weight loss.

column.value: User Favorites

column.name: description_en
column.value: Your favorite meals that you have created. Add custom meals with your own macros.

column.name: benefits_en
column.value: Personalized diet with meals that match your tastes and goals.
